message.content: Columbia University is a private Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. Founded in 1754 as King's College, it is one of the oldest institutions of higher education in the United States. Columbia is known for its rigorous academic programs, distinguished faculty, and significant contributions to research across a wide range of disciplines, including the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, engineering, medicine, law, business, and journalism. The university’s main campus is situated on the Morningside Heights neighborhood of Manhattan, while its medical center and other specialized schools are spread throughout the city. Columbia consistently ranks among the top universities worldwide and has produced numerous Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and leaders in various fields.
